allowPermissionsDesc: Ikayatsidwa, mafoni onse a MCP adzavomerezedwa okha popanda kuwonetsa zokambirana. Izi zimagwira ntchito padziko lonse lapansi pazokambirana zonse, kuphatikiza macheza atsopano.

runtimeSettings.title: Zikhazikiko za Runtime
runtimeSettings.description: Konzani momwe Novera imasamalirira ndi kuyesanso ma seva a MCP.
runtimeSettings.toolCallTimeoutDesc: Nthawi yokwanira kuti mudikire MCP yankho la chida musanathe nthawi.
runtimeSettings.maxToolOutputCharsDesc: Zotsatira zazitali kwambiri zomwe zimasungidwa pazokambirana. Chilichonse chapitachi chimakonzedwa ndikuyikidwa ngati chocheperako, kotero chotsatira chimodzi chachikulu sichingathetseretu nkhani yachitsanzocho. Khazikitsani 0 kuti zotsatira zonse zikhale bwino.
runtimeSettings.smartToolRoutingDesc: Ikayatsidwa, Novera imasankha ma seva oyenera MCP musanalowetse zida. Letsani kuti muzitsegula zonse MCP mndandanda wa zida zonse.
runtimeSettings.useLightweightRouterModelDesc: Pamene njira yanzeru yayatsidwa, yendetsani njira yosiyana (nthawi zambiri yaing'ono) m'malo mwa macheza. Zimitsani kuti mugwiritse ntchito njira yochezera nthawi zonse.
runtimeSettings.routerModelDesc: Sankhani wopereka ndi chitsanzo pamalo amodzi. Mitundu yopepuka yokha ndiyomwe yatchulidwa kuti njirayo ikhale yachangu komanso yotsika mtengo.
runtimeSettings.routerModelEmptyList: Palibe mitundu yopepuka yomwe ilipo. Onjezani mtundu wocheperako kapena konzani makiyi a API mu Ma Models.
